# Kesbie Nguyễn

> Personal site and link archive of Kesbie Nguyễn, a software engineer.

This site is a single page. It collects the small web projects built for fun, for
the author and friends. It is available in Vietnamese (default) and English.

## Pages

- [Vietnamese homepage](https://kesbie.com/): intro and the full list of sites
- [English homepage](https://kesbie.com/en/): English version of the same page

## Projects listed

- [natty-zone.kesbie.com](https://natty-zone.kesbie.com): one of the small projects in the archive

## Notes

- Content is static HTML. No account, no tracking, no cookies.
- Canonical host is https://kesbie.com
